messages:
Sam (CSE): Customer asked for a few items: CycloneDX SBOM, KMS integration/audit proof, and remediation timelines for three flagged CVEs. They want a single package to hand to their security team by next Wednesday.
Alice Chen: ok — assigning triage. Which CVEs specifically?
Sam (CSE): CVE-2026-1010, CVE-2025-8421, CVE-2024-3344. Customer is concerned about runtime exposure and key handling.
Marcos Gómez: quick scan — CVE-2026-1010 affects json-parse-util (runtime path) used in inference request parsing. There's an approved bump in PR #489 that upgrades to 2.1.4 which contains the fix.
Priya Patel: CVE-2024-3344 is in a dev-only tool (local test harness) so low production risk, but we should still surface it in the SBOM with context.
sec-bot: automated-scan: found 3 vulnerabilities across product and infra packages. status: CVE-2026-1010 -> fix PR, QA pending; CVE-2025-8421 -> transitive lib in gpu-driver-utils, vendor patch pending; CVE-2024-3344 -> dev-only, mitigated.
Alice Chen: plan proposal: 1) Push PR #489 through canary on Redwood Dedicated next Tue. 2) For CVE-2025-8421 (vendor patch pending), apply runtime workaround (feature-flag-based guard) and document timeline. 3) Include dev-only CVE as advisory in SBOM.
Marcos Gómez: ETA for PR merge + canary: merge Fri, canary Mon/Tue, full rollout Wed (if no regressions). We can backport hotfix to the last stable minor if customer needs earlier.
Priya Patel: SBOM generation snippet I ran locally (CycloneDX):
```
# generate cyclonedx SBOM for service image
syft packages:cyclonedx -o sbom.json ./service-image:latest
```
Sample payload entry we will include: {"name":"json-parse-util","version":"2.1.3","fix":"2.1.4","cve":"CVE-2026-1010","scope":"runtime"}
Kevin (Legal): for SOC2 evidence we need: a) the SBOM file, b) a short attestation describing exposure/risk and remediation plan, c) KMS audit snippet showing key use and rotation events. We also need sign-off from Eng leads before I issue a formal letter.
Alice Chen: KMS audit proof — ops can export CloudKMS audit logs. Example (redacted) entry: 
```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-01T14:22:09Z","protoPayload":{"methodName":"crypto.decrypt","resourceName":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/ir-key","authenticationInfo":{"principalEmail":"redwood-inference@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"}}}
```
We can produce a short bundle of recent key uses + rotation event and sign it.
Marcos Gómez: note — our KMS integration uses CMEK via customer-managed keys for Dedicated. We can provide the audit export and a short architecture note explaining HSM/KMS flow to satisfy compliance requests.
Priya Patel: I'll assemble SBOM + short mitigation notes (runtime vs dev) and mark CVE statuses. Will include transitive dependency tree snippet for CVE-2025-8421.
Sam (CSE): customer requested a timeline and a one-page summary. I'll tell them: SBOM + KMS audit bundle by Tue EOD, remediation plan and rollout schedule by Wed. They asked for anything signed?
Kevin (Legal): I'll prepare a short attestation template; I need Eng sign-off (Alice/Marcos) before I attach it.
Alice Chen: I can sign once PRs are merged and we have the exported KMS logs. Marcos, can you verify canary schedule by EOD? :eyes:
Marcos Gómez: will confirm canary schedule and post PR status here. If customer wants earlier, we can backport to stable and do a hotfix release — that'll need SRE-window.
sec-bot: ticket created: S-4321 (customer-evidence-kms-cve). linked items: PR-489, SBOM-1772, audit-export-1772.
Sam (CSE): I'll attach S-4321 to the customer thread and request acceptance of the proposed timeline.
Kevin (Legal): I'll queue the attestation draft; target sign-off by Thu EOD so we can deliver a signed statement with the package.
Alice Chen: sounds good. Action items: Marcos -> confirm canary timing; Priya -> SBOM + mitigations; Sam -> customer comms; Kevin -> attestation.
Marcos Gómez: ack :thumbsup:
Priya Patel: will post SBOM artifact link here when ready.
Sam (CSE): thanks everyone — I'll update customer after we have the KMS logs and SBOM.
Kevin (Legal): Please copy me on the SBOM and the exact KMS log export boundaries so I can reference them in the attestation.
Alice Chen: noted. Closing loop here once artifacts are uploaded to S-4321.
